dig.name: Dig
dig.effect:
User digs underground for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.

During the immune turn, earthquake, fissure, and magnitude still hit the user normally, and their power is doubled if appropriate.

The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of lock on, mind reader, or no guard.

This move cannot be selected by sleep talk.

fly.name: Fly
fly.effect:
User flies high into the air for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.

During the immune turn, gust (2x dmg), hurricane, sky uppercut, smack down, thunder, twister (2x dmg), and whirlwind still hit the user normally.  Gust and twister also have double power against the user.

The damage from hail and sandstorm still applies during the immune turn.

The user may be hit under the effect of lock on, mind reader, or no guard.

This move cannot be used while gravity is in effect.

This move cannot be selected by sleep talk.

hex.name: Hex
hex.effect: If the target has a major status ailment, this move has double power.

acid.name: Acid
acid.effect: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by one stage.

bide.name: Bide
bide.effect: User waits for two turns.  On the second turn, the user inflicts twice the damage it accumulated on the last Pokémon to hit it.  Damage inflicted is typeless.

bind.name: Bind
bind.effect: For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn.

bite.name: Bite
bite.effect: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

coil.name: Coil
coil.effect: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, and accuracy by one stage each.

dive.name: Dive
dive.effect:
User dives underwater for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.

During the immune turn, surf, and whirlpool still hit the user normally, and their power is doubled if appropriate.

The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of lock on, mind reader, or no guard.

This move cannot be selected by sleep talk.

gust.name: Gust
gust.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.

If the target is under the effect of bounce, fly, or sky drop, this move will hit with double power.

hail.name: Hail
hail.effect: Changes the weather to hail for five turns, during which non-ice Pokémon are damaged for 1/16 their max HP at the end of every turn.

haze.name: Haze
haze.effect: Removes stat, accuracy, and evasion modifiers from every Pokémon on the field.

howl.name: Howl
howl.effect: Raises the user's Attack by one stage.

leer.name: Leer
leer.effect: Lowers the target's Defense by one stage.

lick.name: Lick
lick.effect: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

mist.name: Mist
mist.effect: Pokémon on the user's side of the field are immune to stat-lowering effects for five turns. Defog used by an opponent will end this effect.

rage.name: Rage
rage.effect: Every time the user is hit after it uses this move but before its next action, its Attack raises by one stage.

rest.name: Rest
rest.effect: User falls to sleep for two turns, replacing any existing non-volatile status ailments, and immediately regains all its HP.

roar.name: Roar
roar.effect: Switches the target out for another of its trainer's Pokémon selected at random.  Wild battles end immediately.

smog.name: Smog
smog.effect: Has a 40% chance to poison the target.

soak.name: Soak
soak.effect: Changes the target to pure water-type until it leaves the field.  If the target has multitype, this move will fail.

surf.name: Surf
surf.effect:
Inflicts regular damage.

If the target is in the first turn of dive, this move will hit with double power.

wish.name: Wish
wish.effect: At the end of the next turn, user will be healed for half its max HP.  If the user is switched out, its replacement will be healed instead for half of the user's max HP.  If the user faints or is forcefully switched by roar or whirlwind, this effect will not activate.

wrap.name: Wrap
wrap.effect:
For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn.  

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times.

yawn.name: Yawn
yawn.effect: Puts the target to sleep at the end of the next turn.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.

block.name: Block
block.effect: The target cannot switch out normally.

brine.name: Brine
brine.effect: If the target has less than half its max HP remaining, this move has double power.

charm.name: Charm
charm.effect: Lowers the target's Attack by two stages.

clamp.name: Clamp
clamp.effect:
For the next 2–5 turns, the target cannot leave the field and is damaged for 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn.  If the user leaves the field, this effect ends.

Has a 3/8 chance each to hit 2 or 3 times, and a 1/8 chance each to hit 4 or 5 times.  Averages to 3 hits per use.

covet.name: Covet
covet.effect:
If the target is holding an item and the user is not, the user will permanently take the item.  Damage is still inflicted if an item cannot be taken.

Pokémon with sticky hold or multitype are immune to the item theft effect.

The target cannot recover its item with recycle.

curse.name: Curse
curse.effect:
If the user is a ghost: user pays half its max HP to place a curse on the target, damaging it for 1/4 its max HP every turn.
Otherwise: Lowers the user's Speed by one stage, and raises its Attack and Defense by one stage each.

The curse effect is passed on by baton pass.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move.

defog.name: Defog
defog.effect:
Lowers the target's evasion by one stage.  Clears away fog.  Removes the effects of mist, light screen, reflect, safeguard, spikes, stealth rock, and toxic spikes from the target's side of the field.

If the target is protected by mist, it will prevent the evasion change, then be removed by this move.

ember.name: Ember
ember.effect: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

feint.name: Feint
feint.effect:
Removes the effects of detect or protect from the target before hitting.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move, nor selected by assist or metronome.

flail.name: Flail
flail.effect:
Power varies inversely with the user's proportional remaining HP.

64 * current HP / max HP | Power
-----------------------: | ----:
 0– 1                    |  200
 2– 5                    |  150
 6–12                    |  100
13–21                    |   80
22–42                    |   40
43–64                    |   20

flash.name: Flash
flash.effect: Lowers the target's accuracy by one stage.

fling.name: Fling
fling.effect:
Power and type are determined by the user's held item.  The item is consumed.  If the user is not holding an item, or its item has no set type and power, this move will fail.

This move ignores sticky hold.

If the user is under the effect of embargo, this move will fail.

growl.name: Growl
growl.effect: Lowers the target's Attack by one stage.

lunge.name: Lunge
lunge.effect: Lowers the target's Attack by one stage.

mimic.name: Mimic
mimic.effect: This move is replaced by the target's last successfully used move, and its PP changes to 5.

pluck.name: Pluck
pluck.effect:
If the target is holding a berry, this move has double power, and the user takes the berry and uses it immediately.

If the target is holding a jaboca berry or rowap berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect.

If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move's damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen.

quash.name: Quash
quash.effect: Forces the target to act last this turn, regardless of Speed or move priority.  If the target has already acted this turn, this move will fail.

roost.name: Roost
roost.effect: Heals the user for half its max HP.  If the user is flying, its flying type is ignored until the end of this turn.

scald.name: Scald
scald.effect: Has a 30% chance to burn the target.

slash.name: Slash
slash.effect: User's critical hit rate is one level higher when using this move.

snarl.name: Snarl
snarl.effect: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by one stage.

snore.name: Snore
snore.effect: Only usable if the user is sleeping.   Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

spark.name: Spark
spark.effect: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

spite.name: Spite
spite.effect: Lowers the PP of the target's last used move by 4.  If the target hasn't used a move since entering the field, if it tried to use a move this turn and failed, or if its last used move has 0 PP remaining, this move will fail.

stomp.name: Stomp
stomp.effect:
Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

Power is doubled against Pokémon that have used minimize since entering the field.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.effect: Target is forced to only use damaging moves for the next 3–5 turns, selected at random.

thief.name: Thief
thief.effect:
If the target is holding an item and the user is not, the user will permanently take the item.  Damage is still inflicted if an item cannot be taken.

Pokémon with sticky hold or multitype are immune to the item theft effect.

The target cannot recover its item with recycle.

This move cannot be selected by assist or metronome.

toxic.name: Toxic
toxic.effect: Badly poisons the target.  Never misses when used by a poison-type Pokémon.

trick.name: Trick
trick.effect: User and target permanently swap held items.

absorb.name: Absorb
absorb.effect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

assist.name: Assist
assist.effect:
Uses a move from another Pokémon in the user's party, both selected at random.  Moves from fainted Pokémon can be used.  If there are no eligible Pokémon or moves, this move will fail.

This move will not select assist, chatter, circle throw, copycat, counter, covet, destiny bond, detect, dig, dive, dragon tail, endure, feint, fly focus punch, follow me, helping hand, me first, metronome, mimic, mirror coat, mirror move, phantom force protect, quick guard, roar shadow force, sketch, sleep talk, snatch, struggle, switcheroo, thief, trick, whirlwind, or wide guard.

bestow.name: Bestow
bestow.effect: Transfers the user's held item to the target.  If the user has no held item, or the target already has a held item, this move will fail.

bounce.name: Bounce
bounce.effect:
User bounces high into the air for one turn, becoming immune to attack, and hits on the second turn.  Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

During the immune turn, gust, hurricane, sky uppercut, smack down, thunder, and twister still hit the user normally.  gust and twister also have double power against the user.

The damage from hail and sandstorm still applies during the immune turn.

The user may be hit during its immune turn if under the effect of lock on, mind reader, or no guard.

This move cannot be used while gravity is in effect.

charge.name: Charge
charge.effect: Raises the user's Special Defense by one stage.  If the user uses an electric move next turn, its power will be doubled.

crunch.name: Crunch
crunch.effect: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by one stage.

detect.name: Detect
detect.effect:
No moves will hit the user for the remainder of this turn.  If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail.

If the user successfully used detect, endure, protect, quick guard, or wide guard on the last turn, this move has a 50% chance to fail.

encore.name: Encore
encore.effect: The next 4–8 times (selected at random) the target attempts to move, it is forced to repeat its last used move.

endure.name: Endure
endure.effect: The user's HP cannot be lowered below 1 by any means for the remainder of this turn.

facade.name: Facade
facade.effect: If the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned, this move has double power.

growth.name: Growth
growth.effect: Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by one stage each.  During sunny day, raises both stats by two stages.

grudge.name: Grudge
grudge.effect: If the user faints before it next acts, the move that fainted it will have its PP dropped to 0.  End-of-turn damage does not trigger this effect.

harden.name: Harden
harden.effect: Raises the user's Defense by one stage.

nuzzle.name: Nuzzle
nuzzle.effect: Has a 100% chance to paralyze the target.

return.name: Return
return.effect: Power increases with happiness, given by `happiness * 2 / 5`, to a maximum of 102.  Power bottoms out at 1.

sketch.name: Sketch
sketch.effect:
Permanently replaces itself with the target's last used move.  If that move is chatter or struggle, this move will fail.

This move cannot be copied by mimic or mirror move, nor selected by assist or metronome, nor forced by encore.

sludge.name: Sludge
sludge.effect: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

snatch.name: Snatch
snatch.effect:
The next time a Pokémon uses a beneficial move on itself or itself and its ally this turn, the user of this move will steal the move and use it itself.  Moves which may be stolen by this move are identified by the "snatchable" flag.

If two Pokémon use this move on the same turn, the faster Pokémon will steal the first beneficial move, and the slower Pokémon will then steal it again—thus, only the slowest Pokémon using this move ultimately gains a stolen move's effect.

If the user steals psych up, it will target the Pokémon that used psych up.  If the user was the original target of psych up, and the Pokémon that originally used it's affected by pressure, it will only lose 1 PP.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move, nor selected by assist or metronome.

spikes.name: Spikes
spikes.effect: Scatters spikes around the opposing field, which damage opposing Pokémon that enter the field for 1/8 of their max HP.  Pokémon immune to ground moves are immune to this damage, except during gravity.  Up to three layers of spikes may be laid down, adding 1/16 to the damage done: two layers of spikes damage for 3/16 max HP, and three layers damage for 1/4 max HP.

splash.name: Splash
splash.effect:
Does nothing.

This move cannot be used while gravity is in effect.

tickle.name: Tickle
tickle.effect: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by one stage.

uturn.name: U-turn
uturn.effect:
Inflicts regular damage, then the user immediately switches out, and the trainer selects a replacement Pokémon from the party.  If the target faints from this attack, the user's trainer selects the new Pokémon to send out first.  If the user is the last Pokémon in its party that can battle, it will not switch out.

The user may be hit by pursuit when it switches out, if it has been targeted and pursuit has not yet been used.

This move may be used even if the user is under the effect of ingrain.

uproar.name: Uproar
uproar.effect: User is forced to use this move for 2–5 turns, selected at random. No Pokemon can sleep during the effect of this move.

agility.name: Agility
agility.effect: Raises the user's Speed by two stages.

amnesia.name: Amnesia
amnesia.effect: Raises the user's Special Defense by two stages.

attract.name: Attract
attract.effect: Causes the target (req. opposite gender) to fall in love with the user, giving it a 50% chance to do nothing each turn.

barrier.name: Barrier
barrier.effect: Raises the user's Defense by two stages.

beatup.name: Beat Up
beatup.effect:
Inflicts typeless regular damage.  Every Pokémon in the user's party, excepting those that have fainted or have a major status effect, attacks the target.  Calculated stats are ignored; the base stats for the target and assorted attackers are used instead.  The random factor in the damage formula is not used.  dark Pokémon still get STAB.

This effect breaks through wonder guard.

bulkup.name: Bulk Up
bulkup.effect: Raises the user's Attack and Defense by one stage each.

chatter.name: Chatter
chatter.effect: Has either a 1%, 11%, or 31% chance to confuse the target, based on the volume of the recording made for this move; louder recordings increase the chance of confusion.  If the user is not a chatot, this move will not cause confusion.

copycat.name: Copycat
copycat.effect:
Uses the last move that was used successfully by any Pokémon, including the user.

This move cannot copy itself, nor roar nor whirlwind.

counter.name: Counter
counter.effect: Targets the last opposing Pokémon to hit the user with a physical move this turn.  Inflicts twice the damage that move did to the user.

disable.name: Disable
disable.effect: Disables the target's last used move, preventing its use for 4–7 turns, selected at random, or until the target leaves the field.

embargo.name: Embargo
embargo.effect:
Target cannot use its held item for five turns.  If the target leaves the field, this effect ends.

If a Pokémon under this effect uses bug bite or pluck on a Pokémon holding a berry, the berry is destroyed but not used.  If a Pokémon under this effect uses fling, it will fail.

This effect is passed by baton pass.

fissure.name: Fissure
fissure.effect:
OHKO Move.  Ignores accuracy and evasion modifiers.  This move's accuracy is 30% plus 1% for each level the user is higher than the target.  If the user is a lower level than the target, this move will fail.

Endure still prevents the target from fainting.

The effects of lock on, mind reader, and no guard still apply, as long as the user is equal or higher level than the target.

flatter.name: Flatter
flatter.effect: Raises the target's Special Attack by one stage, then confuses it.

gravity.name: Gravity
gravity.effect:
For five turns (including this one), all immunities to ground moves are disabled.  For the duration of this effect, the evasion of every Pokémon on the field is lowered by two stages.  Cancels the effects of bounce, fly, and sky drop.

Specifically, flying Pokémon and those with levitate or that have used magnet rise are no longer immune to ground attacks, arena trap, spikes, or toxic spikes.

bounce, fly, sky drop, high jump kick, jump kick, and splash cannot be used while this move is in effect.

*Bug*: If this move is used during a double or triple battle while Pokémon are under the effect of sky drop, Sky Drop's effect is not correctly canceled on its target, and it remains high in the air indefinitely.  As Sky Drop prevents the target from acting, the only way to subsequently remove it from the field is to faint it.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.effect: Has a 100% chance to burn the target.

ingrain.name: Ingrain
ingrain.effect:
Prevents the user from switching out.  User regains 1/16 of its max HP at the end of every turn.  If the user was immune to ground attacks, it will now take normal damage from them.

roar and whirlwind will not affect the user.  The user cannot use magnet rise.

kinesis.name: Kinesis
kinesis.effect: Lowers the target's accuracy by one stage.

lockon.name: Lock-On
lockon.effect: If the user targets the same target again before the end of the next turn, the move it uses is guaranteed to hit.

memento.name: Memento
memento.effect: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by two stages.  User faints.

outrage.name: Outrage
outrage.effect: User is forced to attack with this move for 2–3 turns,selected at random.  After the last hit, the user becomes confused.

payday.name: Pay Day
payday.effect: After the battle ends, the winner receives five times the user's level in extra money for each time this move was used.

payback.name: Payback
payback.effect: If the target uses a move or switches out this turn before this move is used, this move has double power.

present.name: Present
present.effect:
Randomly uses one of the following effects.

Effect                                             | Chance
-------------------------------------------------- | -----:
Inflicts regular damage with 40 power  |    40%
Inflicts regular damage with 80 power  |    30%
Inflicts regular damage with 120 power |    10%
Heals the target for 1/4 its max HP    |    20%

On average, this move inflicts regular damage with 52 power and heals the target for 1/20 its max HP.

protect.name: Protect
protect.effect: No moves will hit the user for the remainder of this turn. If the user is last to act this turn, this move will fail. Success rate drops by 1/2 on successive attempts.

psybeam.name: Psybeam
psybeam.effect: Has a 10% chance to confuse the target.

psychic.name: Psychic
psychic.effect: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by one stage.

psywave.name: Psywave
psywave.effect: Inflicts typeless damage between 50% and 150% of the user's level, selected at random in increments of 10%.

pursuit.name: Pursuit
pursuit.effect:
If the target attempts to switch out this turn before the user acts, this move hits the target before it leaves and has double power.

This effect can still hit a Pokémon that switches out when it has a substitute up or when an ally has used follow me.

recover.name: Recover
recover.effect: Heals the user for half its max HP.

recycle.name: Recycle
recycle.effect:
User recovers the last item consumed by the user or a Pokémon in its position on the field.  The item must be used again before it can be recovered by this move again.  If the user is holding an item, this move fails.

Items taken or given away by covet, knock off, switcheroo, thief, or trick may not be recovered.

reflect.name: Reflect
reflect.effect: Reduces damage from physical attacks by half for five turns. In double battles, the reduction is 1/3.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.effect: Removes a burn, paralysis, or poison from the user.

revenge.name: Revenge
revenge.effect:
If the target damaged the user this turn and was the last to do so, this move has double power.

pain split does not count as damaging the user.

rollout.name: Rollout
rollout.effect: User is forced to use this move for five turns.  Power doubles every time this move is used in succession to a maximum of 16x, and resets to normal after the lock-in ends.

screech.name: Screech
screech.effect: Lowers the target's Defense by two stages.

spitup.name: Spit Up
spitup.effect:
Power is equal to 100 times the amount of energy stored by stockpile.  Ignores the random factor in the damage formula.  Stored energy is consumed, and the user's Defense and Special Defense are reset to what they would be if stockpile had not been used.  If the user has no energy stored, this move will fail.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move.

swagger.name: Swagger
swagger.effect: Raises the target's Attack by two stages, then confuses it.  If the target's Attack cannot be raised by two stages, the confusion is not applied.

swallow.name: Swallow
swallow.effect: Heals the user depending on the amount of energy stored by stockpile: 1/4 its max HP after one use, 1/2 its max HP after two uses, or fully after three uses.  Stored energy is consumed, and the user's Defense and Special Defense are reset to what they would be if stockpile had not been used.  If the user has no energy stored, this move will fail.

thunder.name: Thunder
thunder.effect:
Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

During rain dance, this move has 100% accuracy.

During sunny day, this move has 50% accuracy.

torment.name: Torment
torment.effect: Prevents the target from attempting to use the same move twice in a row.

twister.name: Twister
twister.effect:
Has a 20% chance to make each target flinch.

If the target is under the effect of bounce, fly, or sky drop, this move will hit with double power.

workup.name: Work Up
workup.effect: Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by one stage each.

astonish.name: Astonish
astonish.effect: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.effect:
Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

During hail, this move has 100% accuracy.

bugbite.name: Bug Bite
bugbite.effect:
If the target is holding a berry, the user takes the berry and uses it immediately.

If the target is holding a jaboca berry or rowap berry, the berry is still removed, but has no effect.

If this move is super effective and the target is holding a berry that can reduce this move's damage, it will do so, and will not be stolen.

bugbuzz.name: Bug Buzz
bugbuzz.effect: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by one stage.

bulldoze.name: Bulldoze
bulldoze.effect: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by one stage.

endeavor.name: Endeavor
endeavor.effect: Inflicts exactly enough damage to lower the target's HP to equal the user's.  If the target's HP is not higher than the user's, this move has no effect.  Type immunity applies, but other type effects are ignored.  This effect counts as damage for moves that respond to damage.

eruption.name: Eruption
eruption.effect: Power increases with the user's remaining HP and is given by `150 * HP / max HP`, to a maximum of 150 when the user has full HP.

fakeout.name: Fake Out
fakeout.effect: Causes the target to flinch.  Can only be used on the user's first turn after entering the field.

glaciate.name: Glaciate
glaciate.effect: Lowers the target's Speed by one stage.

headbutt.name: Headbutt
headbutt.effect: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

iceball.name: Ice Ball
iceball.effect: User is forced to use this move for five turns.  Power doubles every time this move is used in succession to a maximum of 16x, and resets to normal after the lock-in ends.

icebeam.name: Ice Beam
icebeam.effect: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target.

iceburn.name: Ice Burn
iceburn.effect: Has a 30% chance to burn the target.  User charges for one turn before attacking.

icefang.name: Ice Fang
icefang.effect: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target and a separate 10% chance to make the target flinch.

icywind.name: Icy Wind
icywind.effect: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by one stage.

imprison.name: Imprison
imprison.effect: Prevents any Pokémon on the opposing side of the field from using any move the user knows until the user leaves the field.  This effect is live; if the user obtains new moves while on the field, these moves become restricted.

judgment.name: Judgment
judgment.effect:
If the user is holding a plate or a drive, this move's type is the type corresponding to that item.

Note: This effect is technically shared by both techno blast and judgment; however, Techno Blast is only affected by drives, and Judgment is only affected by plates.

lowkick.name: Low Kick
lowkick.effect:
Power increases with the target's weight in kilograms, to a maximum of 120.

Target's weight | Power
--------------- | ----:
Up to 10kg      |    20
Up to 25kg      |    40
Up to 50kg      |    60
Up to 100kg     |    80
Up to 200kg     |   100
Above 200kg     |   120

mefirst.name: Me First
mefirst.effect:
If the target has selected a damaging move this turn, the user will copy that move and use it against the target, with a 50% increase in power.

If the target moves before the user, this move will fail.

meditate.name: Meditate
meditate.effect: Raises the user's Attack by one stage.

minimize.name: Minimize
minimize.effect:
Raises the user's evasion by two stages.

Stomp and Steamroller have double power against Pokémon that have used this move since entering the field.

mudbomb.name: Mud Bomb
mudbomb.effect: Has a 30% chance to lower the target's accuracy by one stage.

mudshot.name: Mud Shot
mudshot.effect: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by one stage.

mudslap.name: Mud-Slap
mudslap.effect: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's accuracy by one stage.

overheat.name: Overheat
overheat.effect: Inflicts regular damage, then lowers the user's Special Attack by two stages.

psychup.name: Psych Up
psychup.effect:
Discards the user's stat changes and copies the target's.

This move cannot be copied by mirror move.

psyshock.name: Psyshock
psyshock.effect: Damage calculation always uses the target's Defense, regardless of this move's damage class.

reversal.name: Reversal
reversal.effect:
Power varies inversely with the user's proportional remaining HP.

64 * current HP / max HP | Power
-----------------------: | ----:
 0– 1                    |  200
 2– 5                    |  150
 6–12                    |  100
13–21                    |   80
22–42                    |   40
43–64                    |   20

skydrop.name: Sky Drop
skydrop.effect:
User carries the target high into the air for one turn, during which no moves will hit either Pokémon and neither can act.  On the following turn, the user drops the target, inflicting damage and ending the effect.

If the target is flying-type, this move will function as normal but inflict no damage.

gust, hurricane, sky uppercut, smack down, thunder, twister, and whirlwind can hit both the user and the target during this effect.  gust and twister will additionally have double power.

The damage from hail and sandstorm still applies during this effect.

Either Pokémon may be hit during this effect if also under the effect of lock on, mind reader, or no guard.
